notes: «شهدت عمرو بن أبي حسن سأل عبد الله بن زيد» — the father witnessed Amr's question (Amr is in the scene); Abdullah b. Zayd answers by performing the ablution, so he is the last link (rule 6); this is an act, not a spoken answer
«وحدثنا موسى ... مسح رأسه مرة» differs in wording and names another head: variant group
